spec2def(ncpa.cpl ncpa.spec)

# ncpa.cpl is all Rust (ncpa-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/ncpa-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# ncpa.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/ncpa-rust/src/ncpa/ncpa.rs)
add_cargo_module(ncpa ncpa-cargo ncpa.cpl
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE ncpa-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32)
